name: Aonsoku-BS Tagger
author: Aonsoku-BS
description: Lets Navidrome admins edit the tags of their music from Aonsoku-BS. Edits arrive from the Aonsoku-BS server and are written into the files here.

library.reason: To write the edited tags into the music files. Needs "Allow write access".

matcher.reason: To find the file of each song being edited

websocket.reason: To receive tag edits from the Aonsoku-BS server and send back the results

http.reason: To check, with Navidrome itself, that each edit comes from an admin

subsonicapi.reason: To check that the editing user is an admin, and to rescan edited folders

users.reason: To check the editing user, and to rescan as the configured admin

scheduler.reason: To keep the connection to the Aonsoku-BS server open

taskqueue.reason: To write files one at a time

cache.reason: To remember the connection between calls

syncServerUrl.title: Aonsoku-BS server
syncServerUrl.description: The address of your Aonsoku-BS web app, e.g. https://@SYNC_HOST@

secret.title: Shared secret
secret.description: The same value as TAGGER_PLUGIN_SECRET on the Aonsoku-BS server

scanUser.title: Admin user for rescans
scanUser.description: A Navidrome admin the plugin rescans edited folders as

navidromeUrl.title: Navidrome, as seen from inside its container
navidromeUrl.description: Used to check each editor's sign-in. Change it only if Navidrome uses another port or a base URL.
